method: per-class 1-D quantile targets from Original's held-out target fold (2500 validation images), shifted by -1.5 log-odds (data-size calibration, chosen on development split 42 only); log-odds MSE on clean eval-mode forget batches at every 9th retain step, forget gradient clipped to 5 then retain CE (augmented, frozen BN) added; SGD lr .003 momentum .9 wd 5e-4; returned model = last.pt after epoch 10

selection_evidence: dev split 42 vs Retrain-42 on validation replica: AvgGap 0.648 (selection-only 0.972); SalUn 1.147 (1.136). Chosen among ~60 dev runs; endpoint noise across epochs/configs about +-0.4, so the dev number is optimistic.
